entries.why: THE PROVENANCE STOPS BEING RENDERED, THE SENTENCE STARTS SAYING SOMETHING, AND A REFUSED READ STOPS BEING SILENT. (1) `source` — 'tenants/{id}/invoices, summed from amount (cents) over a complete read' — was rendered under every line as AlertDescription and ItemDescription. It is KEPT as a required field and no longer rendered: a comment cannot be asserted, whereas a mandatory field means a branch that emits a sentence without naming its read does not compile, and the-276-dashboard-overview already pins that. `collapsible` and `tooltip` were both rejected — a disclosure still shows the schema to the same pastor one tap away, and a tooltip is unreachable on a phone. (2) A line is now emitted only when the week has a SHAPE the card cannot draw — shapeOf names drought, firstIn and highest — because the Members card already carries the count, the sparkline and a '+N% vs last week' badge, and repeating it adds nothing. The comparison needs NO new read: useOverviewData already returns TREND_WEEKS weekly buckets, so the previous period was always in hand. The `contacts` insight is DROPPED rather than padded: it is a lone getCountFromServer figure with no series, so there is no shape to find, and adding a read to give it something to say is the one thing this ticket forbids. (3) An `unavailable` series now emits its own destructive `alert` line carrying the REASON, whether it is the only refusal or one of three; before, it was skipped silently and a total refusal rendered as 'Nothing in this ministry's data records anything that changed this week' — a claim about the DATA made when the READ had failed, the Silent-Failure Rule's quiet lie. STEADY is only ever reached when at least one series came back complete and none came back refused. (4) Both `Sparkles` are gone — the WidgetFrame header icon and the `flat` direction glyph — and nothing else on this panel implied a model. `alert` and `item` were ALREADY imported here from THE-276 and gain no new adopter; no primitive is added, edited or hand-substituted, and the file still spells zero inline styles.
